title: Section-normalized coordinates for strict towers
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its specified algebra structure. Use the actual quotient rings $A_n=\mathcal O_E/(\ell)^{n+1}$, the strict coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], their ordinary derived categories [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], and the constructible finite-Tor tower category [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. For every section-normalized presentation $b$ of [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], the interface SpTowerCalculus.Coordinates(b) is inhabited: there is an abelian strict-system presentation at every scheme, an ordinary evaluation comparison which is identity on every section, and for every quotient a comparison between the system scalar extension and the intrinsic constant-ring scalar extension. The ordinary restriction comparison fixes sections, and the scalar comparison preserves the specified adjunction unit.

source.place: Local pairs: identify the ordinary strict tower section model before constructing any geometric map.; specialized to the existing section-normalized Lean interfaces.

proof.text: Uncurry the actual product-site module sheaf into strict systems using [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. The section, restriction and morphism normalizations identify both ordinary evaluations with the original module at (n,U); these identities give a natural isomorphism whose section maps are identities.

For every iterated quotient, the two restriction functors have identical section modules and scalar action. The scalar adjunction of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections] and the normalized scalar models of [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian] give the unique left-adjoint comparison. The unit equation for this comparison is the ScalarCoordinates unit field. Assemble these comparisons for every scheme and quotient.
